title: PRESIDENT OF INDIA PRESENTS SPORTS AND ADVENTURE AWARDS 2025
body_text: The President of India, Smt Droupadi Murmu presented the Sports and Adventure Awards 2025 at a function held at Rashtrapati Bhavan today (November 13, 2026). The Awards include Dronacharya Awards, 2025; Arjuna Awards, 2025; Tenzing Norgay National Adventure Awards, 2024; and Rashtriya Khel Protsahan Puraskar, 2025.
